name: alpaca
tests: Alpaca server simulator on an httpx mock transport, discovery over local UDP

estimate.devices: hundreds of models, every ASCOM device reachable through ASCOM Remote
estimate.reasoning: Alpaca is the network form of ASCOM, the standard driver interface for astronomy gear on Windows. ASCOM Remote exposes every installed ASCOM driver over Alpaca, and a growing number of mounts, focusers and observatory controllers use Alpaca natively on Linux and embedded boards. The count is a model estimate.
